title: termal_evaluate_acceptance schema does not state its 16-distinct-record cap on criterionEvidence
outcome: The termal_evaluate_acceptance tool description and schema state both criterionEvidence limits (at most 16 criteria and at most 16 distinct records), so callers can size their evidence before calling.
acceptance: The termal_evaluate_acceptance tool description or schema (for example maxItems or a description note) states that criterionEvidence may select at most 16 criteria and at most 16 distinct records, and a test asserts that the advertised limit equals the enforced one.
disposal_reason: Duplicate: Opus2 and Fable2 filed the same 16-distinct-record contract gap at the same time (Engram::Fable #7673/#7675). w-30b524c2bc6b carries it. It renders the limit from the constant and binds a behavioural refusal test, which avoids a test that only pins schema text against the constant.
